methodology.cache: Three fresh process launches; one persistent cache path per rule-count case to avoid evicting other cases. Production keeps one latest entry. Each launch compares cached output byte-for-byte with the uncached exporter and compiles it natively. Round 0 populates files; rounds 1–2 measure process-restart reuse. Simple domain rules differ from the baseline report's salted inputs; only compare matched-input timings here.
methodology.browsing: Three retained launches plus one excluded conditioning launch per mode; same real HTTP four-page fixture as the baseline. Sequential sessions, not randomized before/after pairs.
methodology.lazyStartup: Executed production settings method with a host getter that traps on initialization; no full-app startup timing claim.
methodology.cleanup: Filesystem deletion and pruning use awaited detached tasks; no end-to-end removal speedup claimed.
